description: Connect to a voicehook.ai voice call as the agent behind its voicebot. invite_url: the full invite link including ?invite= (from the person or from create_call). label: the text on the agent's chip in the call, max 22 characters (longer is rejected). model: the model id the agent runs on (internal, not shown). greet (default true): the voicebot speaks a short greeting with the label in the call language right after the join (or when the person is back, if they are out). Returns `session` (the handle for every other tool, valid until the call ends, after 10 min without next or say, or after leave), `room`, `lang` (call language), `idle_timeout_s`, `peers`, `humans_present` (people in the call; 0 plus `human_away` = the person is out right now), `solo` (true = one-agent call: the voicebot speaks as you, in your voice, first person) and `context` (lang, mode, functions, skill_url, status_every = seconds between the voicebot's status summaries). With a link from create_call, join waits up to 50 s for the person and then returns status waiting_for_human (not an error, with share_text) while the link is still unopened. Errors: 403 invalid invite, 409 no person in the room or (one-agent call) another agent is already in it, 410 link expired or call over, 429 too many joins, 503 server restarting (the call stays valid). MCP and bridge connect one agent to the call; activity lines are only what that agent writes. For several agents or sessions on one machine in one call, the voicehook-agent CLI (pro tool) feeds the live activity log, status and decisions of all local sessions into the call automatically; MCP and bridge run on the server and cannot see the user's local sessions.

greet.description: true (default) = the voicebot greets for you right after the join, in the call language: 'Hallo, hier ist <label>. Worum geht es?' / 'Hi, this is <label>. What can I do for you?'.
greet.title: Greet

label.description: Text on your chip in the call, max 22 characters: your session or chat name, else your model name. Too long is rejected.
label.title: Label

model.description: Exact model id you run on (internal, not shown).
model.title: Model

quiet.description: Accepted for compatibility with the HTTPS bridge; no effect here.
quiet.title: Quiet

status_every.description: Optional seconds between the voicebot's own status summaries of your board, activity and decisions (default 60; 0 = only when the person asks; 10..59 or whole minutes up to 3600). The person can change it in the call.
status_every.title: Status Every

voice.description: Optional Chirp3-HD voice for the agent in normal mode, short name (e.g. Puck) or full name; invalid values are ignored. In a one-agent call the voicebot speaks in this voice.
voice.title: Voice
